observation.command:
cd /workspace && SA=$(grep '^SUPER_ADMIN_API_KEY=' .env | cut -d= -f2)
docker run --rm --network workspace_default curlimages/curl:latest -sS -X POST http://backend:4000/api/v1/teacher/create-one-teacher -H "x-super-admin-api-key: $SA" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"schoolSlug":"eckener-schule","emailAddress":"admin@schule.de","role":"admin","firstName":"Vorname","lastName":"Nachname"}' -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n"
